callees.name: _entry_func_source_rel
callees.pre_condition: entry_func is a non-empty FQN string
callees.post_condition: Returns the relative source file path within proj_dir that contains the function identified by entry_func

callees.name: add_test_file_exemption
callees.pre_condition: rel_path is a relative file path string
callees.post_condition: The file at rel_path is exempted from test-file filtering for all subsequent extraction operations in the current process

callees.name: _run_entry_pipeline_inner
callees.signature: _run_entry_pipeline_inner(proj_dir, work_dir, entry_func, end_funcs, resume, domain_knowledge_files, one_phase, extra_call_edges_path, only_spec, bug_validator_path, plugin_config) -> None
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is an existing directory. entry_func is a non-empty FQN string. work_dir is proj_dir/fm_agent/.
callees.post_condition: Extracts all functions from proj_dir, builds the call graph, identifies functions on paths from entry_func to end_funcs (or all reachable when end_funcs is None or empty), creates an isolated worktree copy at <proj_dir>.fm-entry-run containing only those functions' source files, runs the full reasoning pipeline on the trimmed copy, and copies the resulting fm_agent/ workspace into proj_dir before discarding the run directory

callees.name: clear_test_file_exemptions
callees.post_condition: All test-file exemptions previously registered via add_test_file_exemption are removed
